description: This file defines a controller for handling report-related API requests in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes methods for creating reports, generating preview HTML, listing reports/templates, and deleting reports. It also contains utility classes for handling Word document template processing.

classes.name: WordTemplateReplacer
classes.description: Utility static class providing methods for replacing content controls, populating tables, and filling rich text lists within Word documents using OpenXML SDK.

classes.name: ReportRequestDto
classes.description: Data transfer object representing the payload for creating a report, including project ID, report template ID, version name, and description.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: API controller class for managing reports, including actions for creating, listing, previewing, and deleting reports, as well as generating report files from templates.

methods.name: ReplaceContentControls
methods.description: Replaces content controls in a Word document body with provided values based on SDT tags.

methods.name: PopulateTableAtBookmark
methods.description: Finds a bookmark in the Word document and populates its associated table with provided row data.

methods.name: ReplaceSdtText
methods.description: Helper method to replace the text inside an SDT element in Word documents.

methods.name: PopulateRichTextList
methods.description: Populates a rich text list in the Word document with a sequence of items based on a template SDT.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new report, generating files from templates or Word documents and saving attachments.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list reports or templates with optional limit.

methods.name: PreviewReport
methods.description: Generates an HTML preview of the project report.

methods.name: GetReportsInternal
methods.description: Private method to fetch a list of reports or templates with limit and filtering.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a report by ID, with audit logging.
